tools.name: rex_get_user_profile
tools.description: The Rex user this server is signed in as: user id, name, email, whether they own the account, position and default office. Good first call. POST /v1/rex/UserProfile/read.

tools.name: rex_list_accessible_accounts
tools.description: The Rex agency accounts (account_id and name) this user can sign in to. A user with several accounts picks one with the Account id field when connecting. POST /v1/rex/UserProfile/getAccessibleAccounts.

tools.name: rex_describe_search_fields
tools.description: The field names a search on the given service accepts in criteria, each with its label, type and (for enums) the value list. Call this before building criteria on a field you are not sure of. Sorting (order_by) uses a separate list of sortable fields whose names can differ (for example name_last, no

tools.name: rex_list_value_lists
tools.description: The names of Rex's value lists (the allowed ids for fields such as note types, reminder types, lead sources and property categories). Use a name with rex_get_value_list. POST /v1/rex/SystemValues/getValueCategories.

tools.name: rex_get_value_list
tools.description: The allowed values (id and label) of one value list, for example property_category. The ids are what writes and criteria expect. POST /v1/rex/SystemValues/getCategoryValues.

tools.name: rex_autocomplete_contacts
tools.description: Quick lookup of contacts by (part of) a name: returns the best matches with id, name, email and phone. Use the id with rex_get_contact. POST /v1/rex/Contacts/autocomplete.

tools.name: rex_autocomplete_listings
tools.description: Quick lookup of listings by (part of) an address: returns the best matches with listing id and address. Use the id with rex_get_listing. POST /v1/rex/Listings/autocomplete.

tools.name: rex_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts (people and companies). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: contact.name_full, contact.name_first, contact.name_last, contact.email_address, contact.phone_number, contact.type, contact.tags, con

tools.name: rex_search_listings
tools.description: Search listings (properties for sale or rent). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: listing.system_listing_state (for example "current"), listing.system_publication_status, listing.price_match, listing.listing_a

tools.name: rex_search_properties
tools.description: Search properties (the physical addresses behind listings, appraisals and tenancies). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: property.system_search_key, property.adr_suburb_or_town, property.adr_postcode, property

tools.name: rex_search_leads
tools.description: Search leads (enquiries from portals, the website and email). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: lead.contact_id, lead.listing_id, lead.property_id, lead.assignee_id, lead.lead_source_id, lead.lead_status_id,

tools.name: rex_search_appraisals
tools.description: Search appraisals (listing presentations / market appraisals). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: appraisal_date, appraisal_state, appraisal_type_id, agent_id, property_id, listing_id, pipeline_stage_id, expec

tools.name: rex_search_tenancies
tools.description: Search tenancies (property management leases). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: id, property_id, system_record_state, lease_current_expiry, crt.contact_id. POST /v1/rex/Tenancies/search.

tools.name: rex_search_reminders
tools.description: Search reminders (follow-up tasks) linked to contacts, properties and listings. Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: reminder_date, system_completed_time, remindee_user_id, contact_id, property_id, listing_id, r

tools.name: rex_search_appointments
tools.description: Search appointments (calendar items such as inspections and meetings). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). The searchable fields follow Reminders (reminder_date, remindee_user_id, contact_id, property_id, listing_id). Call re

tools.name: rex_search_notes
tools.description: Search notes recorded against contacts and properties. Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: system_ctime, system_created_user_id, id. Call rex_describe_search_fields with service Notes for related contact and pr

tools.name: rex_search_deals
tools.description: Search deals (the sales pipeline). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: deal.deal_state, deal.expected_close_date, deal.archive_date, deal.tags, deal.description. POST /v1/rex/Deals/search.

tools.name: rex_search_activities
tools.description: Search activities (the log of calls, emails and other actions on records). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: parent_object_type, parent_object_id, type_id, system_ctime, system_created_user_id. POST /v1/rex/A

tools.name: rex_search_listing_events
tools.description: Search listing events (open homes and inspections). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Call rex_describe_search_fields with service ListingEvents for the searchable fields. POST /v1/rex/ListingEvents/search.

tools.name: rex_search_users
tools.description: Search the users (staff) of the agency account. Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Useful fields: first_name, last_name, email, status, user_group_id. User ids are used elsewhere as agent, assignee and remindee ids. POST /v1

tools.name: rex_search_campaigns
tools.description: Search campaigns (nurture and marketing campaigns with their members). Filters (criteria) combine with AND; results are paged with offset/limit (next_offset says where to continue). Call rex_describe_search_fields with service Campaigns for the searchable fields. POST /v1/rex/Campaigns/search.

tools.name: rex_get_contact
tools.description: One contact by id (names, emails, phones, addresses, tags, relationships and the related properties and listings). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Contacts/read.

tools.name: rex_get_listing
tools.description: One listing by id (state, price, agents, the property with its attributes, images, related contacts and events). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Listings/read.

tools.name: rex_get_property
tools.description: One property by id (address, attributes (bedrooms, land area and so on), features, owners and the property's history). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Properties/read.

tools.name: rex_get_lead
tools.description: One lead by id (contact, source, status, assignee and the original enquiry). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Leads/read.

tools.name: rex_get_appraisal
tools.description: One appraisal by id (date, state, agents, property, price expectations and commission estimate). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Appraisals/read.

tools.name: rex_get_tenancy
tools.description: One tenancy by id (property, tenants, lease dates and rent). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Tenancies/read.

tools.name: rex_get_note
tools.description: One note by id (text, type and the contacts and properties it is linked to). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Notes/read.

tools.name: rex_get_deal
tools.description: One deal by id (state, value, parties and expected close date). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Deals/read.

tools.name: rex_get_reminder
tools.description: One reminder by id (description, date, remindee, completion state and linked records). The id comes from a search or autocomplete. POST /v1/rex/Reminders/read.

tools.name: rex_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a new person contact in Rex with a name and optionally one email and one phone. Search first (rex_autocomplete_contacts) to avoid duplicates. Not retried. Returns the new contact id. POST /v1/rex/Contacts/create.

tools.name: rex_create_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to one or more contacts and/or properties (for example after a call or an open home). Not retried. Returns the new note id. POST /v1/rex/Notes/create.

tools.name: rex_create_reminder
tools.description: WRITE: create a follow-up reminder (task) due on a date, optionally linked to a contact, property or listing and assigned to a user (default: Rex's default remindee). Not retried. Returns the new reminder id. POST /v1/rex/Reminders/create.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
